#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef long double ld;
typedef unsigned long long ull;

const int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0};
const int dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

int n, t, rx, ry;
string lab[20], sci[20];
int mem[12][12][12][12][62];
int cap[250][250], par[250];
int dist[20][20], vis[20][20];

inline bool good(int x, int y){
	return 0 <= x && x < n && 0 <= y && y < n && lab[x][y] != 'Y' && lab[x][y] != 'Z';
}

void pre(){
	memset(dist, 0x3f, sizeof(dist));
	memset(vis, 0, sizeof(vis));
	dist[rx][ry] = 0;
	vis[rx][ry] = 1;
	queue<int> qx, qy;
	qx.push(rx);
	qy.push(ry);
	while(!qx.empty()){
		int x = qx.front(); qx.pop();
		int y = qy.front(); qy.pop();
		for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++){
			int nx = x + dx[k];
			int ny = y + dy[k];
			if(good(nx, ny) && !vis[nx][ny]){
				dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
				vis[nx][ny] = 1;
				qx.push(nx);
				qy.push(ny);
			}
		}
	}
}

int dfs(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, int ptr){
	if(ptr > t)return 0;
	int &ret = mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr];
	if(ret != -1)return ret;
	if(x0 == x1 && y0 == y1)return dist[x0][y0] >= ptr;
	if(dist[x0][y0] <= ptr)return ret = 0;
	for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++){
		int nx = x0 + dx[k];
		int ny = y0 + dy[k];
		if(good(nx, ny) && dfs(nx, ny, x1, y1, ptr + 1))return ret = 1;
	}
	return ret = 0;
}

bool fml(int s, int t){
	memset(par, -1, sizeof(par));
	par[s] = -2;
	queue<int> qu;
	qu.push(s);
	while(!qu.empty()){
		int v = qu.front(); qu.pop();
		for(int i = s; i <= t; i++){
			if(par[i] == -1 && cap[v][i] > 0){
				par[i] = v;
				qu.push(i);
			}
		}
	}
	return par[t] != -1;
}

int main(){
	ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
	cin.tie(NULL);
	cout<<setprecision(32);

	cin>>n>>t;
	for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){
		cin>>sci[i];
	}
	for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){
		cin>>lab[i];
	}
	vector<pair<int, int> > pos;
	vector<int> lc, sc;
	for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){
		for(int j = 0; j < n; j++){
			if(sci[i][j] == 'Z'){
				rx = i;
				ry = j;
			}else if('0' <= sci[i][j] && sci[i][j] <= '9'){
				pos.push_back({i, j});
				lc.push_back(lab[i][j] - '0');
				sc.push_back(sci[i][j] - '0');
			}
		}
	}
	int m = pos.size();
	memset(cap, 0, sizeof(cap));
	for(int i = 0; i < m; i++){
		cap[0][i + 1] = sc[i];
		cap[m + 1 + i][2*m + 1] = lc[i];
	}
	pre();
	memset(mem, -1, sizeof(mem));
	for(int i = 0; i < m; i++){
		for(int j = 0; j < m; j++){
			if(dfs(pos[i].first, pos[i].second, pos[j].first, pos[j].second, 0)){
				cap[i + 1][m + 1 + j] = 1000;
			}
		}
	}
	int flow = 0;
	while(fml(0, 2*m + 1)){
		int t = 2*m + 1;
		int nflow = 1e6;
		while(par[t] >= 0){
			nflow = min(nflow, cap[par[t]][t]);
			t = par[t];
		}
		t = 2*m + 1;
		while(par[t] >= 0){
			cap[par[t]][t] -= nflow;
			cap[t][par[t]] += nflow;
			t = par[t];
		}
		flow += nflow;
	}
	cout<<flow;

	return 0;
}
